# Documesh — federated developer documentation for humans and AI agents

> Documentation that agents can not only read, but operate.
> Federated developer documentation from 18 vendors, version-cited, license-attributed.
> Powered by WebMCP.

## Agent interface

This site exposes WebMCP tools via `document.modelContext.registerTool()`.

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `search_docs_across` | Federated search across 18 vendors; results carry vendor, version, license, canonical URL |
| `explain_error` | Log excerpt → closest matching documentation sections across vendors |
| `list_vendors` | Vendor registry with license and attribution requirements |

## Pages

- [Home](https://documesh.selatan.org/index.html): Overview and stats
- [App](https://documesh.selatan.org/app.html): Chat interface with WebMCP tools
- [Capabilities](https://documesh.selatan.org/capabilities.html): Tool documentation with schemas
- [WebMCP Tools](https://documesh.selatan.org/webmcp.html): Tool reference with inputSchema
- [Coverage](https://documesh.selatan.org/coverage.html): Vendors, licenses, legal exclusions
- [Submit Vendor](https://documesh.selatan.org/submit.html): Request documentation ingestion

## API

- GET /health: Service health and snapshot date
- GET /search?q=&vendors=&limit=: Federated documentation search
- GET /explain?error=&vendor=: Error-to-docs matching with extracted signatures
- GET /vendors: Vendor registry with license details

## Sources

Documentation ingested from official vendor-published machine interfaces
(llms.txt, .md endpoints) or open-licensed git repositories. No scraping.
Full attribution on every response. See /coverage for the complete list.
